name: ReadTaskRepeater
caption: Read task repeater

configuration.description: Exactly one SmartField placeholder '{{name}}': the rows output of a Form task repeater section (e.g. '{{<formSlug>_<section>}}'), one row of it ('{{<formSlug>_<section>[2]}}'), or the currentItem of a For Each over it. Read in its raw form.

The columns the step reads, rows of { name, type, tableNo }: a copy of the "columns" of the repeater output the input points at. The editor takes them over from the Form task (also through a For Each) and refreshes them whenever another step of the flow is edited; in hand-written JSON keep them equal to the repeater's fields.
The column: the name of a field of the repeater section. Becomes the output name.
"reference" for a column whose form field has type reference, else "value".
Only for type "reference": the form field's tableNo.

outputs.name: <columns[].name>
outputs.when: one per columns[] row, in order; type 'reference' with that row's tableNo when columns[].type = "reference". {{slug_column}} is the column of the first row the input holds (for one row, e.g. a For Each currentItem: of that row), {{slug_column[i]}} of the i-th row (0-based). Not written when the input holds no row.

outputs.name: count
outputs.when: always - the number of rows read

rules.check: The configuration dialog refuses to save while the repeater is empty. (The step's own check 'Choose the repeater of a form task to read.' is not run.)
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: configuration.input must be exactly one placeholder {{name}}. Anything else resolves to nothing: the step reads no rows and only writes count "0", without an error.

configuration.columns should list the repeater's columns; without them the step writes only count. The step's own check ('The step knows no columns of %1. Choose the repeater of a form task and save the step.') is not run.
The input holds plain values, or records that are not rows of a Form task repeater (%1 = the input)
rules.message: %1 is not a repeater of a form task. Choose the repeater output of a Form task step, or one row of it.

notes: Not a task step itself: it creates no task, does not wait, and is not restricted to background triggers. It is only useful after a Form task.
The step reads the columns named in its own configuration.columns at run time; the Form task's current fields are not consulted.
An input that resolves to nothing (for example a repeater the person left empty) is not an error: count is "0" and no column output is written.
